title: MAP-S05-03 - Holding the Line Tactical Map

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The ritual clearing becomes a battlefield because the ward itself is under pressure. The Custodian and Keystone hold the center while old security bodies and audit-cold spirits test every gap around them.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: The ritual clearing becomes a battlefield because the ward itself is under pressure. The Custodian and Keystone hold the center while old security bodies and audit-cold spirits test every gap around them.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Clarify first-wave positioning without replacing the finale hub map.

sections.title: GM notes
items: The Custodian and Keystone hold the center; PCs form a protective ring while skeletons rise Close and wraiths pressure from Far.
Skeletons rise from Close ground; Wraiths drift from Far edges toward the ritual center.
Relentless but procedural; threats follow old infrastructure logic.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This is the tactical view for holding the line: center, defensive ring, emergence points, and clustering danger."
